  query                 sum(rate(http_requests_total{service="checkout"}[5m])) by (instance)
  step                  1h, for 2h
  requires              seasonal decomposition
  reported window       2026-09-04T06:00:00Z .. 2026-09-05T06:00:00Z  (24h, 25 instants)
  history read          2026-09-01T00:00:00Z .. 2026-09-05T06:00:00Z  (102h, warm-up 78h)
  read cost             1 request, 309 points, 3 series

  paging episodes       2, plus 0 flaps that crossed the band without reaching for
  series firing time    5h  (20.83% of the reported window, summed over series)
  paged wall clock      3h  (12.50% of the reported window)
  peak concurrent       2 series firing at 2026-09-04T11:00:00Z
  longest episode       3h from 2026-09-04T11:00:00Z  {instance="web-2"}
  without a verdict     0 of 75 series-instants: 0 cold, 0 absent, 0 undefined
  budget overlap        no linked SLO: set spec.sloRef to the SLO this detector
                        protects, or delete a detector nobody can tie to a burn

  series              firing  flaps  firing time  ratio   cold  absent  undefined
  {instance="web-2"}  1       0      3h           12.50%  0     0       0
  {instance="web-1"}  1       0      2h           8.33%   0     0       0
  {instance="web-3"}  0       0      0s           0.00%   0     0       0

  Every ratio above divides by the reported window. Dividing by the span
  the samples cover, or by the window times the series count, reads lower
  and flatters the detector: the first hides a series that was missing,
  the second shrinks every time the query matches another instance.
